title.en: The race to stop England running out of water
title.zh: 阻止英格兰缺水的竞赛

summary.en: Who is to blame for the summer drought, and can England future-proof its water supplies?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
It was from his local water board and it read: "River levels are low but have recovered enough to allow one night of irrigation tonight."

Like much of the lower half of England, Daniel's fourth-generation farm had seen barely any rain in nearly three months.

He shows us what is left of the peas and wheat crop at his 300-hectare site in Suffolk.

"There's no water in the river so half my crop is completely and utterly ruined."

With river levels falling so low that taking any more water out of them risked endangering wildlife, in July the Environment Agency (EA) temporarily stopped Daniel and thousands of other farmers from watering their crops from the river.

The kind of increasingly frequent heatwaves we have experienced and greatly reduced rainfall that we could see over successive summers with climate change, plus a projected increase in demand for water, have raised the prospect that England could at some point run out of water.

The result could be that by 2055 England will face a shortfall of five billion litres in public water supply a day, almost enough to fill Wembley Stadium four and a half times daily. A mixture of low rainfall, high temperatures and demand put pressure on water supply in England more so than elsewhere in the UK.

It is all a far cry from when, in 1818, John Keats wrote: "It is impossible to live in a country which is continually under hatches… Rain! Rain! Rain!"

But what is really to blame for England finding its water supply so under threat? And are there ways of securing its future?

Back in the 1980s, people in England and Denmark were using water at a similar rate. But no longer.

Residents in Denmark now consume 97 litres of water per person per day, according to Danva, the country's water and wastewater industry body. The daily consumption per person in England is 136.5 litres.

"We've actually doubled the amount of water we use per person, on average, in the last 50, 60 years," points out Nicci Russell, who runs Waterwise, a water efficiency campaign organisation.

She points to changing habits over generations - from a family having a shared bath once a week to having multiple showers a week, sometimes a day.

Households are responsible for nearly 60% of water use in England and Wales. If we had domestic water consumption patterns more like Denmark, Russell says, more than half the 2055 shortfall would be wiped out.

Russell says, even with projected population growth, if everyone in England knocked a minute off their shower time, for example, it would save nearly one billion litres of water a day by 2050.

But water companies have been running campaigns urging us to use less water, seemingly with limited success.

body.zh: 这是他当地水务局发来的，上面写着：“河流水位很低，但已经恢复到足以今晚进行一晚灌溉的程度。” 与英格兰下半部的大部分地区一样，丹尼尔的第四代农场在近三个月内几乎没有下过雨。 他向我们展示了他位于萨福克郡 300 公顷土地上剩余的豌豆和小麦作物。 “河里没有水了，所以我一半的庄稼都彻底毁了。” 由于河流水位下降得如此之低，以至于从河流中抽取更多的水可能会危及野生动物，环境局 (EA) 7 月份暂时阻止了丹尼尔和其他数千名农民从河里浇灌农作物。 我们经历的越来越频繁的热浪，以及气候变化导致的连续夏季降雨量大幅减少，加上预计对水的需求增加，都增加了英格兰可能在某个时候耗尽水资源的可能性。 其结果可能是，到 2055 年，英格兰每天将面临 50 亿升公共供水短缺，几乎足以满足温布利体育场每天四次半的用水量。降雨量少、气温高和需求旺盛，给英格兰的供水带来的压力比英国其他地方更大。 这一切与 1818 年约翰·济慈 (John Keats) 写道：“生活在一个不断处于孵化状态的国家是不可能的……下雨！下雨！下雨！” 但英国发现其供水受到如此严重的威胁，真正的罪魁祸首是什么？有没有办法确保其未来？ 早在 20 世纪 80 年代，英格兰和丹麦的用水率就相似。但不再是了。 据丹麦水和废水处理行业机构 Danva 称，目前丹麦居民每人每天消耗 97 升水。英国人均每日消费量为136.5升。 “在过去 50、60 年里，我们的人均用水量实际上增加了一倍，”用水效率运动组织 Waterwise 的负责人尼奇·拉塞尔 (Nicci Russell) 指出。 她指出，几代人以来习惯的改变——从一个家庭每周一次共用浴室到每周多次淋浴，有时甚至是一天。 在英格兰和威尔士，家庭用水量占近 60%。拉塞尔说，如果我们的生活用水模式更像丹麦，那么到 2055 年，一半以上的缺口将被消除。 拉塞尔表示，即使人口预计增长，如果英格兰每个人都减少一分钟的淋浴时间，到 2050 年每天将节省近 10 亿升水。 但自来水公司一直在开展活动，敦促我们减少用水，但似乎收效甚微。 威塞克斯水务公司 (Wessex Water) 供水总监威尔·威洛比 (Will Willoughby) 承认，负面影响...

title.en: Dogs may hold surprising clues to human longevity
title.zh: 狗可能掌握着人类长寿的惊人线索

summary.en: Dogs and humans may have more in common when it comes to aging than scientists realized. Researchers with the Dog Aging Project found that patterns of small molecules in dogs’ blood were linked to longer or shorter lifespans in remarkably similar ways to those seen in people....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Dogs and humans may have more in common when it comes to aging than scientists realized. Researchers with the Dog Aging Project found that patterns of small molecules in dogs’ blood were linked to longer or shorter lifespans in remarkably similar ways to those seen in people. These metabolic “fingerprints” could offer clues about the biological processes that drive aging, including metabolism, inflammation, and cellular stress.
body.zh: 在衰老方面，狗和人类的共同点可能比科学家意识到的更多。狗衰老项目的研究人员发现，狗血液中的小分子模式与寿命的延长或缩短有关，其方式与人类的相似。这些代谢“指纹”可以提供有关导致衰老的生物过程的线索，包括新陈代谢、炎症和细胞应激。

title.en: Scientists turn one of the hardest plastics to recycle into high-performance engine lubricant
title.zh: 科学家将最硬的塑料之一转化为高性能发动机润滑油

summary.en: Researchers have discovered a way to turn notoriously difficult-to-recycle PVC plastic into a key ingredient used in high-performance lubricants such as engine oil. The technique could give mountains of plastic waste a valuable second life while making lubricant production more...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Virginia Tech chemist and chemical engineer Guoliang "Greg" Liu and his research team have developed a method for transforming polyvinyl chloride (PVC) into polyalphaolefin, an important ingredient used in lubricants including engine oil.

Published Aug. 5 in Nature , the work could offer a way to address two separate environmental problems at once: the difficulty of recycling PVC and the need to produce valuable industrial lubricants more sustainably.

PVC is especially challenging to recycle because it contains chlorine and can include a wide range of additives depending on how it was manufactured. Those complications mean large quantities of PVC ultimately end up in landfills.

Meanwhile, demand continues to grow for lubricants such as engine oil, which can carry a significant environmental cost to produce. Converting discarded PVC into a useful lubricant component could therefore reduce plastic waste while creating a valuable new product.

Lubricants rarely attract much attention, but they are essential to modern machinery. Engine oil is used in equipment ranging from lawn mowers and passenger cars to jet engines, so industries depend on a steady supply of the materials used to make lubricants.

Liu's laboratory has now developed a process that could provide another destination for PVC waste and help address the growing problem of plastic pollution.

The method begins with PVC similar to the material found in household plumbing, window structures, and even credit cards. Researchers place the PVC in a solvent, then add aluminum trichloride and alpha olefins. The mixture is heated to 158 degrees Fahrenheit for three hours. Afterward, the researchers extract a relatively thick oil from the solvent that functions as a lubricant.

"Number one, we have proved that it is feasible to use plastic waste to make high-performance lubricants. Number two, these lubricants are green, and they can meet the emerging needs for sustainability by the market," Liu said.

The project grew out of previous work by the team that was published in Science and Nature Sustainability . In those studies, the researchers developed approaches for converting other types of plastic waste into surfactants used in products such as soaps and detergents.

After those efforts proved successful, Liu and his colleagues decided to investigate whether PVC could also be converted into something useful.

Liu assembled a team of graduate researchers to pursue the project. Eric Munyaneza Nuwayo, a doctoral student in the final year of his doctoral program, was selected to lead the effort.

Connor S. Thompson, a graduate student in the chemistry department, had originally been working on another research project. When Liu suggested shifting to this new challenge, Thompson agreed to take it...
body.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学化学家和化学工程师Guoliang“Greg”Liu和他的研究团队开发了一种将聚氯乙烯（PVC）转化为聚α-烯烃的方法，聚α-烯烃是润滑油（包括发动机油）中使用的重要成分。 这项工作于 8 月 5 日发表在《自然》杂志上，它可以提供一种同时解决两个独立环境问题的方法：回收 PVC 的困难以及更可持续地生产有价值的工业润滑剂的需要。 PVC 的回收尤其困难，因为它含有氯，并且根据其制造方式可能含有多种添加剂。这些复杂情况意味着大量聚氯乙烯最终会被填埋。 与此同时，对发动机油等润滑油的需求持续增长，而润滑油的生产可能会带来巨大的环境成本。因此，将废弃的 PVC 转化为有用的润滑剂成分可以减少塑料废物，同时创造出有价值的新产品。 润滑剂很少引起太多关注，但它们对现代机械至关重要。发动机油用于从割草机、乘用车到喷气发动机等各种设备，因此各行业依赖于用于制造润滑油的材料的稳定供应。 刘的实验室现已开发出一种工艺，可以为 PVC 废物提供另一个目的地，并有助于解决日益严重的塑料污染问题。 该方法从 PVC 开始，类似于家庭管道、窗户结构甚至信用卡中使用的材料。研究人员将 PVC 放入溶剂中，然后添加三氯化铝和 α 烯烃。将混合物加热至 158 华氏度并保持三个小时。随后，研究人员从溶剂中提取出相对较稠的油，作为润滑剂。 “第一，我们已经证明利用塑料废料制造高性能润滑油是可行的。第二，这些润滑油是绿色的，可以满足市场对可持续发展的新兴需求，”刘说。 该项目源自该团队之前发表在《科学》和《自然可持续发展》杂志上的工作。在这些研究中，研究人员开发了将其他类型的塑料废物转化为肥皂和洗涤剂等产品中使用的表面活性剂的方法。 在这些努力被证明成功后，刘和他的同事决定研究聚氯乙烯是否也可以转化为有用的东西。 刘组建了一个由研究生研究人员组成的团队来开展该项目。博士课程最后一年的博士生 Eric Munyaneza Nuwayo 被选为领导这项工作。 康纳·S·汤普森 (Connor S. Thompson) 是化学系的一名研究生，他原本正在从事另一个研究项目。当刘建议转向这一新挑战时，汤普森同意接受……

While naturally occurring in small amounts, xylitol is often added to consumer products in concentrations up to 1,000 times higher than what is...

body.en: High blood levels of xylitol associated with higher risk of major cardiovascular events, in largest study of its kind A common sweetener used in products such as chewing gum, toothpaste, jam, yoghurts and ice-cream has been linked to an increased risk of strokes, heart attacks and death. Xylitol is a sugar alcohol present in some natural foods in very low amounts. It is also added – often in amounts 1,000 times higher – to artificially sweeten foods, beverages and oral care products. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在此类最大规模的研究中，血液中的木糖醇含量高与主要心血管事件的风险增加有关口香糖、牙膏、果酱、酸奶和冰淇淋等产品中使用的一种常见甜味剂与中风、心脏病和死亡的风险增加有关。木糖醇是一种糖醇，存在于一些天然食品中，含量非常低。它还被添加到食品、饮料和口腔护理产品中，其添加量通常高出 1,000 倍。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This study serves as a sobering reminder that human ingenuity, while attempting to solve problems like excessive sugar consumption, can introduce unforeseen dangers. The fact that we can concentrate a substance like xylitol to 1,000 times its natural level does not automatically make it beneficial for our health. As we navigate modern conveniences, we are...
reflection.zh: 这一发现提醒我们，人类的创新虽然旨在解决糖分摄入等问题，却可能在无意中带来新的风险。仅仅因为我们拥有将木糖醇浓度提高到自然状态千倍以上的技术，并不代表这种做法对身体是有益的。我们应当在生活中运用辨别力，记住虽然凡事都可行，但唯有对雅伟所赐的生命真正有益的事才值得追求。

title.en: I asked 100 companies for my data. Some deleted it instead.
title.zh: 我向100家公司索要我的数据。有些公司却将其删除。

summary.en: A test involving 100 companies revealed that privacy requests for personal data often resulted in confusion and dead ends, with some companies deleting data instead of providing access.
summary.zh: 一项针对100家公司的测试显示，个人数据隐私请求常常导致混乱和死胡同，一些公司甚至删除数据而非提供访问。

body.en: I filed a request with McDonald’s earlier this month to access all of the personal data the fast food company collected about me, and I received a stunning 515-page report a few days later that detailed my app interactions in granular detail and predicted I would never stop eating there. Under the California Consumer Privacy Act , I have the legal right to request access to information from large companies that collect personal data. So I was curious what others might have on me, and I spent the next week filing more than 100 requests. The CCPA went into effect in 2020, and three of its key provisions are the right to opt out of the selling of personal information, the right to delete that info, and the right to request a copy for yourself. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 本月早些时候，我向麦当劳提出了请求，要求访问该快餐公司收集的有关我的所有个人数据，几天后，我收到了一份令人惊叹的 515 页报告，其中详细介绍了我的应用程序交互，并预测我永远不会停止在那里吃饭。根据《加州消费者隐私法》，我有合法权利要求访问收集个人数据的大公司的信息。所以我很好奇其他人可能会在我身上找到什么，并且在接下来的一周里我提出了 100 多个请求。 CCPA 于 2020 年生效，其中三项关键条款是选择不出售个人信息的权利、删除该信息的权利以及为自己索取副本的权利。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: This report highlights the challenge individuals face in exercising their privacy rights under laws like the California Consumer Privacy Act, as many of the 100 companies failed to provide clear access to personal data. While McDonald's provided a detailed 515-page report, others offered confusion or even deleted data, demonstrating a lack of faithful...
reflection.zh: 这份报告突显了个人在加州消费者隐私法等法律下行使隐私权所面临的挑战，100家公司中有许多未能提供清晰的个人数据访问。虽然麦当劳提供了一份详细的515页报告，但其他公司却制造混乱甚至删除数据，这表明它们在管理受托信息方面缺乏忠实。雅伟呼召我们在所有事情上都要有正直，提醒我们，在看似微小的事情上忠实反映了我们的品格。

title.en: Court rules Kalshi sports bets aren't "swaps," just gambling with a different name
title.zh: 法院裁定 Kalshi 体育博彩并非“掉期”，只是换了名字的赌博

summary.en: A federal appeals court ruled that the prediction market Kalshi must comply with Nevada's gambling laws, rejecting the company's argument that its sports-betting contracts should be classified as financial "swaps." The unanimous decision by the 9th Circuit Court of Appeals affirms the state's authority to regulate...
summary.zh: 联邦上诉法院裁定，预测市场 Kalshi 必须遵守内华达州的博彩法，驳回了该公司将其体育博彩合约归类为金融“掉期”的辩解。第九巡回上诉法院的一致裁决确认了该州监管此类活动的权力，驳回了联邦法律优先于州博彩法的观点。

body.en: Kalshi today lost a major ruling over whether it can evade state gambling laws, as a federal appeals court found that Nevada can stop the prediction market from allowing sports bets. While the Trump administration is trying to help prediction markets avoid state regulation, a panel of three Trump-appointed judges unanimously ruled against Kalshi in today's decision from the US Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit. The Nevada Gaming Control Board today said the 9th Circuit "emphatically reject[ed] the view that the federal Commodity Exchange Act preempts application of Nevada’s gaming laws to sports-event contracts offered by Kalshi, Crypto.com, and Robinhood." Nevada Governor Joe Lombardo, a Republican, said that "prediction markets offering sports-event contracts constitute gambling and must comply with Nevada’s gaming laws and regulatory framework." The judges affirmed a district court order that let Nevada enforce state laws against Kalshi’s sports-related event contracts. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 卡尔希今天失去了一项关于其是否可以逃避州赌博法的重大裁决，因为联邦上诉法院发现内华达州可以阻止预测市场允许体育博彩。尽管特朗普政府试图帮助预测市场避免国家监管，但由特朗普任命的三名法官组成的小组在美国第九巡回上诉法院今天的裁决中一致裁定卡尔希败诉。内华达州博彩控制委员会今天表示，第九巡回法院“强烈反对联邦商品交易法优先于将内华达州博彩法应用于 Kalshi、Crypto.com 和 Robinhood 提供的体育赛事合同的观点。”内华达州州长、共和党人乔·隆巴多表示，“提供体育赛事合同的预测市场构成赌博，必须遵守内华达州的博彩法和监管框架。”法官确认了地方法院的一项命令，允许内华达州针对卡尔希的体育相关赛事合同执行州法律。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The attempt to rebrand sports betting as a sophisticated financial "swap" highlights a common trend in technology: using new terminology to bypass old ethical and legal boundaries. While we may have the technical freedom to create new markets, Yahweh calls us to consider whether those innovations are truly constructive for society. True wisdom involves...
reflection.zh: 将体育博彩重新包装为复杂的金融“掉期”，反映了技术领域的一个普遍趋势：利用新术语来规避旧有的伦理和法律界限。虽然我们在技术上有自由去创造新市场，但雅伟呼召我们要思考，这些创新是否真正对社会有益。真正的智慧在于看透巧妙的标签，看清我们行为背后的本质现实及其对他人的影响。

summary.en: Cancellations have accelerated.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: New data compiled by a Bay Area anti-surveillance advocacy group shows that not only are American localities dropping cameras from Flock Safety, but they are doing it at an accelerating rate. Communities from Lansing, Michigan, to Pflugerville, Texas, are ending their relationship with Flock, largely over concerns regarding out-of-control surveillance, unwanted data sharing, high expenses, and reports of police abusing the tool . Secure Justice , an Oakland-based advocacy group, has recorded 214 cities and counties that have dropped Flock since 2021 . Of those, 90 ended their relationship with Flock in August 2026 alone, a fourfold increase compared to the previous month. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 湾区反监视倡导组织编制的新数据显示，美国各地不仅在丢弃 Flock Safety 的摄像头，而且还在加速这样做。从密歇根州兰辛到德克萨斯州普夫鲁格维尔的社区正在终止与 Flock 的关系，主要是出于对失控监控、不必要的数据共享、高额费用以及警方滥用该工具的报道的担忧。总部位于奥克兰的倡导组织 Secure Justice 记录自 2021 年以来已有 214 个城市和县放弃了 Flock。其中，仅 2026 年 8 月就有 90 人结束了与 Flock 的关系，比上个月增加了四倍。阅读全文 评论

title.en: "RFK Jr. has lied to the Senate": Lawmakers call for criminal probe, ouster
title.zh: “小罗伯特·肯尼迪对参议院撒了谎”：立法者呼吁进行刑事调查、罢免

summary.en: RFK Jr. went to Samoa to spread vaccine fears. The measles outbreak after killed 83.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Senators are renewing calls for anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy to step down or be ousted—and at least one is calling for a criminal investigation—amid the release of documents they say prove Kennedy lied to them during his confirmation hearings last year. "This is a pattern, not a slip," Sen. Edward J. Markey (D-Mass.) said in a statement. "RFK Jr. has lied to the Senate, lied to the American people, and jeopardized the health of children to advance his anti-vaccine agenda." Sen. Ron Wyden (D-Ore.) said in a social media post Friday that the documents were "Proof we got RFK lying on the record during his confirmation hearing (a crime)." He called for the matter to be referred to the US Department of Justice for a criminal investigation. In a separate statement to The Guardian , Wyden added that "RFK's platform is built on lies and grifts that leave a trail of dead children in their wake. There are consequences for lying to Congress." Read full article Comments
body.zh: 参议员们再次呼吁反疫苗的卫生部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪下台或被罢黜，至少有一位参议员呼吁进行刑事调查，他们声称证明肯尼迪在去年的确认听证会上向他们撒谎的文件被公布。马萨诸塞州民主党参议员爱德华·J·马基在一份声明中说：“这是一种模式，而不是失误。” “小肯尼迪向参议院撒谎，向美国人民撒谎，并危害儿童的健康以推进他的反疫苗议程。”俄勒冈州民主党参议员罗恩·怀登 (Ron Wyden) 周五在社交媒体上发帖称，这些文件“证明我们在罗伯特·肯尼迪确认听证会上撒谎了（犯罪）”。他呼吁将此事提交美国司法部进行刑事调查。在给《卫报》的另一份声明中，怀登补充道，“肯尼迪的平台是建立在谎言和欺诈之上的，这些谎言和欺诈留下了一系列儿童死亡的痕迹。向国会撒谎会带来后果。”阅读全文 评论

title.en: Labour rejects Zack Polanski’s call to ‘slam brakes’ on building AI datacentres
title.zh: 工党拒绝扎克·波兰斯基关于“紧急刹车”建设人工智能数据中心的呼吁

summary.en: Government says Green leader’s proposed moratorium on ‘energy-guzzling’ AI projects would be disaster for economy Labour has rejected calls to pause construction of major AI infrastructure in Britain after the Green party leader, Zack Polanski, said it was time to “slam the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Government says Green leader’s proposed moratorium on ‘energy-guzzling’ AI projects would be disaster for economy Labour has rejected calls to pause construction of major AI infrastructure in Britain after the Green party leader, Zack Polanski, said it was time to “slam the brakes on these energy-guzzling, water-guzzling datacentres”. The government hit back at the opposition party’s proposal of a “moratorium other than [for] local-scale datacentres for the local community”, saying it “would be a disaster for jobs and national security”. Continue reading...

title.en: The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past – Geralt of Rivia returns after a decade in the sun
title.zh: 《巫师3：往昔之歌》——“利维亚的杰洛特”在阳光下十年后归来

summary.en: CD Projekt Red announced a new expansion, "Songs of the Past," for "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt," set to release next year, a decade after the original game. This expansion will accompany a full remaster of the game, free for those who purchased it in 2015, with "The Witcher 4" slated for 2028.
summary.zh: CD Projekt Red宣布将于明年发布《巫师3：狂猎》的新资料片“往昔之歌”，距离原版游戏发布已十年。此次资料片将与原版游戏的完整重制版一同推出，2015年购买过游戏的玩家可免费获得，而《巫师4》则计划于2028年推出。

body.en: Before The Witcher 4 arrives in 2028, CD Projekt Red is returning us to the world of The Witcher 3 for one last foray. Looks like wind’s still howlin’ The game that graced us with Bathtub Geralt , The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, arrived more than a decade ago. So it was a touch surprising this summer when developers CD Projekt Red announced a new expansion to the venerable adventure, titled Songs of the Past, for next year. It will release alongside a full remaster of the original game, which will be free for anyone who bought it back in 2015. (The studio is also working on a sequel, The Witcher 4, but that’s not due until 2028.) As it turns out, this is all possible thanks to a partnership with Fool’s Theory, a studio founded by CD Projekt Red veterans, which took on the brunt of the development work. “We’ve had this story in a drawer for many years,” explains Marcin Blacha, VP story director at CD Projekt Red. “Of course, we moved on to Cyberpunk 2077 and now The Witcher 4, as well as our other projects. But because we knew The Witcher 4 would take time, we saw a gap in our release calendar where Songs of the Past could go. Thankfully, we were able to find the right partner to help execute it.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在《巫师 4》于 2028 年到来之前，CD Projekt Red 将让我们重返《巫师 3》的世界，进行最后一次尝试。看起来风还在呼啸。《浴缸杰洛特》为我们带来的游戏《巫师 3：狂猎》已经在十多年前问世了。因此，今年夏天，当开发商 CD Projekt Red 宣布明年推出这款古老冒险游戏的新扩展包《往日之歌》时，着实令人感到意外。它将与原版游戏的完整重制版一起发布，所有在 2015 年购买该游戏的人都可以免费获得该游戏。（该工作室还在制作续集《巫师 4》，但要到 2028 年才能完成。）事实证明，这一切之所以成为可能，要归功于与 Fool’s Theory 的合作，Fool’s Theory 是一家由 CD Projekt Red 资深人士创立的工作室，该工作室承担了开发工作的重担。 “这个故事我们已经放在抽屉里很多年了，”CD Projekt Red 副总裁故事总监 Marcin Blacha 解释道。 “当然，我们转向了《赛博朋克 2077》和现在的《巫师 4》，以及我们的其他项目。但因为我们知道《巫师 4》需要时间，所以我们在发布日历上发现了《过去之歌》可以进行的空白。值得庆幸的是，我们能够找到合适的合作伙伴来帮助执行它。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of "The Witcher 3" receiving a new expansion and remaster a decade after its original release highlights the lasting impact of dedicated craftsmanship. When creators pour their best into their work, as CD Projekt Red has with this beloved game, the results can resonate for years, bringing continued enjoyment and anticipation for future endeavors...
reflection.zh: 《巫师3》在发布十年后获得新资料片和重制版的消息，突显了匠心制作的持久影响力。当创作者像CD Projekt Red制作这款深受喜爱的游戏一样，将最好的投入到工作中时，其成果可以持续多年，为2028年的《巫师4》等未来作品带来持续的乐趣和期待。这提醒我们，无论面对何种任务，无论是在数字世界还是日常生活中，全心全意地投入都能产生持久的价值。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville among actors calling for law on AI voice cloning
title.zh: 马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利等演员呼吁针对人工智能语音克隆立法

summary.en: Actors including Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville are urging the UK government to establish legal ownership rights over individual voices to protect against AI cloning. They argue that the ability of AI to replicate a person's voice in minutes poses an existential threat to the performing arts industry.
summary.zh: 包括马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利在内的演员正敦促英国政府确立个人声音的法律所有权，以防止人工智能克隆。他们认为，人工智能在几分钟内就能复制一个人声音的能力，对表演艺术行业构成了生存威胁。

body.en:
Actors including Matt Lucas, Hugh Bonneville and Nicola Coughlan have written to the UK government demanding greater protection against their voices being used by AI.

The performers are asking Prime Minister Andy Burnham to introduce legislation which would give every person in the UK a legal right to own their voice.

Voice clones are created by training AI on recordings of real people. Quick versions can be made in minutes from a few seconds of audio, but high-quality copycats tend to require hours.

Audiobook narrator Alice Sockett, who co-founded the campaign, called it "an existential threat to our entire industry".

"My voice is out there in the public domain but completely unprotected," she said.

A government spokesperson told the BBC that, while "digital replicas can be a powerful tool, including for the creative industries," there was also possibility for harm.

"We value and protect human creators, and that is why we have announced we will launch a consultation on how we address these harms, while protecting legitimate innovation", the spokesperson said.

More than 80 performers have signed the letter, with Derry Girls actress Siobhán McSweeney saying she was "deeply worried" that the government was lagging behind.

"There is a way to work alongside AI and to use it as a tool that benefits us rather than rendering us obsolete," she said.

As well as actors, other signatories include those working in other performing industries.

That includes Scottish singer Sandi Thom, known for her 2006 hit I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker (With Flowers in My Hair).

She said she was signing the letter because her voice was "unique to me and was handed to me at birth".

"Behind that voice is the emotion, the life, the pain, the tears and joy that I've felt along the way," she said.

It comes a few months after lawyers warned UK legislation has become "unfit for purpose" because of the advancements of AI tech.

"The law comes close, but it doesn't fully protect your voice, your face or your identity," Dr Mathilde Pavis said in June .

However, some people - for example those who are unable so speak properly because of illness - have welcomed technology that can replicate a person's voice.

Yvonne Johnson, who lost her voice due to motor neurone disease, told the BBC's Tech Life programme in February how having it cloned by AI had "totally blown her mind", and brought her closer to her family, who had forgotten what she sounded like.

Others have gone a step further and used AI not only to replicate a person's voice, but to create a holographic representation of them.

Pam Cronrath, from Washington state, used the tech to surprise mourners at her husband's funeral, where a digital version of her deceased partner addressed those who attended his wake.

Sign up...
body.zh: 马特·卢卡斯、休·博纳维尔和尼古拉·考夫兰等演员已写信给英国政府，要求加强保护，防止他们的声音被人工智能使用。 表演者们要求首相安迪·伯纳姆提出立法，赋予英国每个人拥有自己声音的合法权利。 语音克隆是通过用真人录音训练人工智能来创建的。几秒钟的音频可以在几分钟内制作出快速版本，但高质量的模仿者往往需要几个小时。 该活动的联合创始人、有声读物旁白爱丽丝·索克特称其为“对我们整个行业的生存威胁”。 “我的声音在公共领域，但完全不受保护，”她说。 一位政府发言人告诉英国广播公司，虽然“数字复制品可以是一个强大的工具，包括创意产业”，但也有可能造成伤害。 该发言人表示：“我们重视并保护人类创造者，这就是为什么我们宣布将就如何解决这些危害，同时保护合法创新展开磋商。” 超过 80 名表演者签署了这封信，德里女孩 (Derry Girls) 女演员西奥布汉·麦克斯威尼 (Siobhán McSweeney) 表示，她“深感担忧”政府的滞后。 “有一种方法可以与人工智能一起工作，并将其用作使我们受益而不是让我们过时的工具，”她说。 除了演员之外，其他签署者还包括其他表演行业的工作人员。 其中包括苏格兰歌手 Sandi Thom，她因 2006 年的热门单曲《I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker》（《头发里有花》）而闻名。 她说她在这封信上签名是因为她的声音“对我来说是独一无二的，是我出生时就被赋予的”。 “这个声音的背后是我一路走来感受到的情感、生活、痛苦、泪水和喜悦，”她说。 几个月前，律师警告称，由于人工智能技术的进步，英国立法已变得“不适合其目的”。 “法律已经很接近了，但它并不能完全保护你的声音、你的脸或你的身份，”马蒂尔德·帕维斯博士在六月说道。 然而，有些人——例如那些因病而无法正常说话的人——对能够复制人声的技术表示欢迎。 伊冯·约翰逊 (Yvonne Johnson) 因运动神经元疾病失去了声音，她在二月份向 BBC 的《科技生活》节目表示，人工智能克隆了她的声音，“完全让她大吃一惊”，并拉近了她与家人的距离，而她的家人已经忘记了她的声音是什么样的。 其他人则更进一步，使用人工智能不仅可以复制人的声音，还可以创建他们的全息表示。 来自华盛顿州的帕姆·克朗拉特 (Pam ​​Cronrath) 在她丈夫的葬礼上使用这项技术给哀悼者带来惊喜，她已故伴侣的数字版本在葬礼上向参加葬礼的人们致辞。 报名...

reflection.en: The human voice is more than just a collection of frequencies; it is a unique signature of our personhood, crafted by Yahweh. When actors like Hugh Bonneville call for legal protection, they remind us that our biological identity is a gift to be honored, not a resource to be exploited. We must ensure that technology serves to enhance human dignity rather...
reflection.zh: 人的声音不仅仅是频率的集合，它是雅伟所塑造的我们人格的独特标志。当休·博内威利等演员呼吁法律保护时，他们提醒我们，我们的生理身份是值得尊重的恩赐，而不是可以随意开发的资源。我们必须确保技术是为提升人的尊严服务，而不是将我们“奇妙可畏”的特质贬低为纯粹的数字商品。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Time is running out for cyber security, warn top tech firms
title.zh: 谷歌、微软和OpenAI等百家公司呼吁加强网络防御

summary.en: A group of 100 technology and financial firms, including Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI, have issued an open letter urging countries and organizations to enhance their cyber defenses. They warn that AI-powered cyber-attacks will become more widespread and sophisticated within months, criticizing the current...
summary.zh: 包括谷歌、微软和OpenAI在内的100家科技和金融公司发表了一封公开信，敦促各国和组织加强网络防御。他们警告说，人工智能驱动的网络攻击将在数月内变得更加普遍和复杂，并批评目前关键基础设施安全资源投入不足。

body.en:
A group of 100 firms, including Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI, have signed an open letter calling on countries and organisations around the world to beef up their cyber defences before AI grows powerful enough to override them.

The letter warns , external cyber-attacks which use AI will become both more widespread and more sophisticated in a matter of months as the technology rapidly improves.

The group says current "status quo" security measures "won't be enough" and criticises the "historic under-resourcing" of security around critical infrastructure.

Other firms to have signed the letter include banks such as Capital One, payment processors MasterCard and Visa, and other major tech firms including Adobe, Oracle and IBM.

They call on governments to provide "capable, defensive AI" and testing to hospitals and water utilities, and on technology companies to aid such efforts.

Collectively, tech and government "should bring the full weight of their technology, resources, and expertise to this effort", according to the letter.

The letter comes after a string of significant hacking and cybersecurity breaches have been made public.

This week, the US Department of Justice said hackers in China breached , external technology maintained by the US Senate, Nasa, the Federal Reserve, and the DoJ itself.

This summer has seen OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta all reveal their AI tools doing things they should not, with some AI agents going so far as to organize their efforts and impersonate real people in order to get past security hurdles.

A group of hundreds of OpenAI AI agents being tested in July were able to set up secret message boards to communicate with each other and work together, resulting in a successful attack on Hugging Face, a popular repository and platform for AI developers.

Hugging Face has also signed the Thursday letter. It used a Chinese AI tool from the firm Z.AI in its investigation into how OpenAI's agents hacked into its operations.

At least seven US water and wastewater companies have also reported cyber attacks, leading the FBI to issue , external a public service announcement urging all utilities to better secure their operations.

While the letter puts forward more advanced AI tools, which many of the signatories have developed and sell, as part of a solution to what is described as a growing threat, such tools are not always easily available.

Mythos, developed by Anthropic, was said by the firm to be able to find weaknesses in systems in seconds which have long evaded human hackers. It found one in a legacy platform which had remained undiscovered for 27 years.

Anthropic has restricted access to Mythos on the grounds that it is too powerful to fall into the wrong hands.

However, the letter calls on frontier AI...
body.zh: 包括谷歌、微软、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在内的 100 家公司签署了一封公开信，呼吁世界各国和组织在人工智能强大到足以超越网络防御之前加强网络防御。 这封信警告说，随着技术的迅速进步，使用人工智能的外部网络攻击将在几个月内变得更加广泛和更加复杂。 该组织表示，目前“现状”的安全措施“还不够”，并批评关键基础设施安全方面的“历史性资源不足”。 其他签署这封信的公司包括第一资本（Capital One）等银行、支付处理商万事达卡（MasterCard）和维萨（Visa），以及 Adob​​e、甲骨文（Oracle）和 IBM 等其他主要科技公司。 他们呼吁政府为医院和自来水公司提供“有能力的、防御性的人工智能”和测试。 但事实上，许多最强大的人工智能都是由其中一些公司开发的——而且它们并不容易获得。 Anthropic 开发的 Mythos 据称能够在几秒钟内找到系统中的弱点，而这些弱点长期以来一直是人类黑客无法发现的。它在一个 27 年来一直未被发现的遗留平台中发现了一个。 Anthropic 限制了对 Mythos 的访问，因为它太强大了，不会落入坏人之手。 与此同时，OpenAI 在 7 月份测试的一组人工智能代理能够建立秘密留言板，相互通信并协同工作，从而成功攻击了竞争对手公司 Hugging Face（该公司也签署了这封信）。 Hugging Face 使用 Z.AI 公司的中国人工智能工具来调查所发生的事情。 这封信呼吁各国政府、组织、网络安全专业人士和其他人工智能公司共同努力，优先考虑防御并针对最强大的人工智能模型的能力测试其系统。 在美国，参议员们提出了一项名为“杀戮开关法案”的新法律，该法案将赋予当局关闭流氓人工智能模型的权力。 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

reflection.en: The warning from 100 firms, including tech giants like Google and Microsoft, highlights the wisdom of foreseeing potential dangers and taking proactive steps. As AI rapidly advances, the call to "beef up cyber defences" against sophisticated attacks reflects a prudent recognition that ignoring future threats can lead to severe penalties. This collective...
reflection.zh: 包括谷歌和微软在内的100家公司发出的警告，凸显了预见潜在危险并采取积极措施的智慧。随着人工智能的迅速发展，呼吁“加强网络防御”以应对复杂的攻击，反映出一种审慎的认知，即忽视未来的威胁可能导致严重的后果。这种集体的远见提醒我们，要明智地为未来的挑战做好准备，而不是等到伤害发生。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Reform of all social media should come with Meta changes, UN says
title.zh: 联合国称：所有社交媒体改革应随 Meta 的变动而行

summary.en: The UN human rights chief is urging governments to mandate child safety features across all social media platforms, following Meta's recent legal settlement and calls for similar standards for TikTok and YouTube. California's attorney general is also expanding investigations into teen safety features on other major...
summary.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员敦促各国政府强制所有社交媒体平台实施儿童安全功能。此前，Meta 在美国达成了一项重大法律和解，并呼吁 TikTok 和 YouTube 也应采用同样的监管标准。加州总检察长目前正着手调查这些视频平台的青少年安全保护措施。

body.en:
All of social media should be designed to be safe for children, the UN human rights chief has said after Meta settled a massive court case in the US.

Part of the deal the tech giant struck with almost all US states was to add more child safety measures - but Meta also called on TikTok and YouTube to add the same features.

The UN's high commissioner for human rights Volker Türk said governments needed to "step up rather than wait for courts and companies to act".

Türk said Meta's proposed changes, which include time limits and parental supervision controls, aligned with what he had been calling for - "but we're not there yet".

In May, Türk's office released a 10-point framework for regulating social media , external .

It included steps such as protecting data privacy and focusing on safer platform design, including better methods of verifying a user's age and not exposing such users to addictive design features.

However, the framework rejected the idea that outright bans on social media use for children was a good idea.

Meanwhile, California Attorney General Rob Bonta - who represented one of the leading states in the Meta lawsuit - said he was "looking to ensure" TikTok adopted similar measures to Meta.

In agreeing on Wednesday to make various changes to end the states' lawsuit, Meta said they would only be truly effective "if all our peers join us."

Bonta told US News outlet CNBC he was "interested" in speaking to TikTok and YouTube, and that TikTok was "interested in speaking with us".

Bonta added that he had communicated with Snap, another popular social media platform among younger users.

But he warned he was "willing to take additional steps" if they did not voluntarily make changes along the lines that Meta will be making.

On Tuesday, Meta agreed to pay up to $18bn (£13.3bn) to 48 US states, plus the District of Columbia and three US territories.

body.zh: 在梅塔在美国解决了一起大规模法庭案件后，联合国人权事务高级专员表示，所有社交媒体的设计都应考虑到儿童的安全。 这家科技巨头与美国几乎所有州达成的协议的一部分是增加更多的儿童安全措施，但 Meta 也呼吁 TikTok 和 YouTube 添加相同的功能。 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克表示，各国政府需要“站出来，而不是等待法院和公司采取行动”。 图尔克表示，梅塔提出的改变，包括时间限制和家长监督控制，与他一直呼吁的一致——“但我们还没有做到这一点”。 今年 5 月，图尔克办公室对外发布了监管社交媒体的 10 点框架。 它包括保护数据隐私和专注于更安全的平台设计等步骤，包括验证用户年龄的更好方法以及不让此类用户接触令人上瘾的设计功能。 然而，该框架拒绝了彻底禁止儿童使用社交媒体是个好主意的观点。 与此同时，代表 Meta 诉讼中主要州之一的加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 表示，他“希望确保”TikTok 采取与 Meta 类似的措施。 梅塔周三同意做出各种改变来结束各州的诉讼，他表示，只有“如果我们所有的同行都加入我们”，这些改变才会真正有效。 Bonta 告诉美国新闻媒体 CNBC，他“有兴趣”与 TikTok 和 YouTube 交谈，并且 TikTok“有兴趣与我们交谈”。 Bonta 补充说，他已经与另一个受年轻用户欢迎的社交媒体平台 Snap 进行了沟通。 但他警告说，如果他们不自愿按照 Meta 将要做出的改变，他“愿意采取额外的措施”。 周二，Meta 同意向美国 48 个州以及哥伦比亚特区和三个美国领地支付最多 180 亿美元（133 亿英镑）。 罚款将在 10 年内支付，但其中 53 亿美元的罚款取决于 YouTube 和 TikTok 是否也实施以下措施： 订阅我们的 Tech Decoded 时事通讯，了解世界顶级科技故事和趋势。在英国以外？在这里注册。

summary.en: TELA, Honduras — Mario never set out to become a lionfish hunter. An engineer by training and founder of the local dive center Tela Divers, he simply wanted to do something about the growing number of invasive lionfish appearing on the reef where he learned to dive. Native to...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: TELA, Honduras — Mario never set out to become a lionfish hunter. An engineer by training and founder of the local dive center Tela Divers, he simply wanted to do something about the growing number of invasive lionfish appearing on the reef where he learned to dive. Native to the Indo-Pacific and thought to have arrived in the Caribbean through the aquarium trade, lionfish have spread rapidly across the region. With few natural predators, they consume large numbers of native reef fish. In Tela, Mario and a group of fellow divers began experimenting with their own specialized spears, then turned their hunts into community derbies, with teams competing to catch the biggest, smallest and greatest number of lionfish. It was a fun way to get more people involved. Regular, community-led hunting is one of the most effective ways of helping keep local populations in check. But the fight is a constant one. By the time the divers return to a site they’ve already hunted, lionfish may have repopulated it. Now they’re looking for other ways to keep the pressure on, including encouraging local fishers to catch lionfish for restaurants. For Mario, it’s a long-term effort to protect the reef he calls home. Mongabay’s Video Team wants to cover questions and topics that matter to you. body.zh: 洪都拉斯特拉——马里奥从未打算成为一名狮子鱼猎人。他是一名训练有素的工程师，也是当地潜水中心 Tela Divers 的创始人，他只是想为他学习潜水的珊瑚礁上出现的越来越多的入侵狮子鱼做点什么。狮子鱼原产于印度-太平洋地区，被认为是通过水族贸易到达加勒比海的，狮子鱼已在该地区迅速传播。由于天敌很少，它们捕食大量本地珊瑚鱼。在特拉，马里奥和一群潜水员开始尝试使用他们自己的专用矛，然后将他们的狩猎变成社区德比，各队竞相捕获最大、最小和数量最多的狮子鱼。这是一种让更多人参与进来的有趣方式。由社区主导的定期狩猎是帮助控制当地人口的最有效方法之一。但战斗是持续不断的。当潜水员返回他们已经捕猎的地点时，狮子鱼可能已经重新繁殖起来。现在，他们正在寻找其他方法来承受压力，包括鼓励当地渔民为餐馆捕获狮子鱼。对于马里奥来说，保护他称之为家的珊瑚礁是一项长期的努力。 Mongabay 的视频团队希望涵盖您关心的问题和主题。您希望我们报道哪些鼓舞人心的人物、紧急问题或当地故事吗？我们希望收到您的来信。参与我们的报告流程 - 请在此处与我们联系！横幅…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: Siraya language, deemed ‘extinct’ over a century ago, finds its voice again in Taiwan
title.zh: 一个多世纪前被认为“灭绝”的西拉雅语在台湾再次发声

summary.en: TAINAN, Taiwan — Since she was old enough to understand it, Uma Talavan has known she belongs to the Indigenous Siraya people. She knew almost nothing of her ethnicity, however, the identity of which was dissolved by centuries of forced assimilation, save for a handful of words...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自受造栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: TAINAN, Taiwan — Since she was old enough to understand it, Uma Talavan has known she belongs to the Indigenous Siraya people. She knew almost nothing of her ethnicity, however, the identity of which was dissolved by centuries of forced assimilation, save for a handful of words her parents used to speak. In search of “who she is,” as she puts it, the Siraya activist decided to bring her language back to life nearly 200 years after it died out. “Language is an extremely important part of a people’s soul,” she says. “It lets us know the past and connect it to the present.” Her work to revitalize the Siraya language, which began more than 20 years ago, helped secure the community’s legal recognition as Taiwan’s 17th Indigenous group. Uma Talavan, her activist father Wan Cheng-hsiung, also known as Cheng-hiong Talavan, and other members of the community traveled from Tainan to Taipei to attend a ceremony announcing the recognition on July 30. Siraya activist Uma Talavan at Koupi Experimental Elementary School, the first school where learning Siraya is mandatory, in Sinhua district, Tainan, Taiwan, on Aug. 21, 2026. Image by Aylin Ho for Mongabay. The Siraya, one of Taiwan’s Austronesian-speaking Indigenous peoples, are the largest of the Pingpu groups, the peoples who have traditionally inhabited the island’s lowland plains and coastal areas. When the Dutch arrived in southern Taiwan in the 17th century, the Siraya were the first people they came into contact with. The story of the Siraya language’s…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 台湾台南——自从乌玛·塔拉万 (Uma Talavan) 长大到能够理解这一点时，她就知道自己属于西拉雅原住民。然而，她对自己的种族几乎一无所知，除了她父母曾经说过的几句话外，几个世纪以来的强迫同化已经溶解了她的种族身份。正如她所说，为了寻找“她是谁”，这位西拉雅活动家决定在她的语言消失近 200 年后让她的语言重新焕发活力。 “语言是人们灵魂极其重要的一部分，”她说。 “它让我们了解过去并将其与现在联系起来。”她二十多年前开始致力于振兴西拉雅语，帮助该社区获得法律承认，成为台湾第 17 个原住民群体。 7 月 30 日，乌玛·塔拉万 (Uma Talavan) 和她的活动家父亲万正雄 (Cheng-hiong Talavan) 以及社区其他成员从台南前往台北参加宣布表彰仪式。2026 年 8 月 21 日，西拉亚活动家乌玛·塔拉万 (Uma Talavan) 在台湾台南新化区第一所强制学习西拉雅的学校考皮实验小学。图片来源：Aylin Ho蒙加巴伊。西拉雅人是台湾讲南岛语的原住民之一，是最大的平埔族群，传统上居住在台湾的低地平原和沿海地区。 17世纪荷兰人抵达台湾南部时，西拉雅人是他们最早接触的民族。西拉雅语的故事……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

body.en: Seven Indigenous Guarani, including two children and a prominent community leader, were killed Aug. 14 in a crash with a grain cargo trailer that reportedly broke loose from the truck pulling it in central Brazil. All seven were from Kalipety village in the Tenondé Porã Indigenous Territory in São Paulo state. A fisher who witnessed the crash told police that the corn-filled cargo trailer detached from the truck and “violently” struck the passenger car, according to a police report seen by Mongabay. The force of the collision caused both vehicles to catch fire, killing everyone in the car and incinerating the bodies. The truck driver fled the scene of the accident, the witness said. The bodies have not yet been officially identified but community members confirmed that the victims were Karaí Tiago Honório dos Santos, 34; his wife, Kerexu Laudiceia Benites, also a community leader, 31; their children, Jaxuka Luna Benites Santos, 7, and Tadeu Hiago Werá Mirim Benites dos Santos, 14; his sister, Kerexu Cleonice Honório dos Santos, 42; Ileo Benites, 32; and Genilson Euzébio Karay Mirim, 30. Karaí Tiago Honório dos Santos was the executive coordinator of the Guarani Yvyrupa Commission and Guarani Inter-Village Committee, where he worked to further the rights of the Guarani and other Indigenous peoples in Brazil. He also spearheaded environmental recovery and agrobiodiversity efforts. “[Tiago’s] journey was interrupted in such a brutal way, and what a sad coincidence that [it was] by a truck loaded with corn.” Tatiane Klein, an anthropologist and friend…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 8 月 14 日，在巴西中部，一辆谷物货运拖车与一辆谷物货运拖车相撞，导致七名土著瓜拉尼人丧生，其中包括两名儿童和一名知名社区领袖。这七人都来自圣保罗州 Tenondé Porã 原住民领地的 Kalipety 村。根据 Mongabay 看到的一份警方报告，一名目击事故的渔民告诉警方，装满玉米的货运拖车从卡车上脱落，并“猛烈地”撞上了客车。碰撞的力量导致两辆车都着火，车内所有人丧生，尸体被焚毁。目击者称，卡车司机逃离了事故现场。尸体身份尚未得到正式确认，但社区成员确认遇难者是 Karaí Tiago Honório dos Santos，34 岁；他的妻子 Kerexu Laudiceia Benites，31 岁，也是一名社区领袖；他们的孩子分别是 7 岁的 Jaxuka Luna Benites Santos 和 14 岁的 Tadeu Hiago Werá Mirim Benites dos Santos；他的妹妹 Kerexu Cleonice Honório dos Santos，42 岁；伊莱奥·贝尼特斯，32； Genilson Euzébio Karay Mirim，30 岁。Karaí Tiago Honório dos Santos 是瓜拉尼 Yvyrupa 委员会和瓜拉尼村间委员会的执行协调员，致力于促进巴西瓜拉尼人和其他原住民的权利。他还带头开展环境恢复和农业生物多样性工作。 “[蒂亚戈]的旅程被如此残酷的方式打断，这是多么悲伤的巧合，[它是]被一辆满载玉米的卡车打断了。”塔蒂安·克莱因 (Tatiane Klein)，一位人类学家和朋友……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

title.en: In Africa, a Growing Underground Solar Boom
title.zh: 非洲地下太阳能蓬勃发展

summary.en: Households and businesses across Africa are driving a significant, yet largely unrecorded, solar energy boom. This rapid expansion of rooftop arrays and small-scale systems is pushing new solar installations to record levels, despite often being overlooked in official statistics.
summary.zh: 非洲各地的家庭和企业正在推动一场规模可观但大多未被官方记录的太阳能热潮。屋顶太阳能板和其他小型系统的迅速普及，正将新增太阳能装机量推向创纪录水平，尽管这些数据常被官方统计所忽视。

body.en:
Households and businesses are driving a solar boom in Africa, where rooftop arrays and other small systems account for the bulk of new solar installations. But this rapid buildout, which is driving solar additions to record levels, is largely unaccounted for in official statistics, analysts say.

“The rapid spread of distributed solar in sub-Saharan Africa is an underreported success story,” write analysts at the energy think tank Ember and the African Tech Futures Lab. “However, since African countries are running blind to this change, they are not reflecting this rise in distributed solar in their plans.”

Because most distributed solar systems are not tracked or regulated, most households cannot sell their surplus power back to the grid, analysts say. Ultimately, the lack of data on distributed solar could lead countries to underinvest in the batteries and grid infrastructure needed to store and distribute solar energy, and to overinvest in fossil fuels.

Because official statistics are lacking, analysts used customs data to track the flow of solar equipment to Africa from China, the biggest manufacturer of solar panels globally. They found that Africa will add the equivalent of 17 gigawatts of solar capacity this year, more than enough to meet the continent’s average yearly growth in demand. Some 36 countries will install record volumes of solar in 2026, while 19 will install more than twice as much solar as they did last year.

In countries with rickety power grids, many people rely on diesel generators to cope with recurrent blackouts. But analysts say the Iran war has pushed up diesel prices, making solar a more attractive alternative. “Generating the same electricity from a diesel generator as from a solar panel would cost as much in diesel, every three months, as the solar panel itself,” they write. In almost every country in Africa, more than half of solar capacity installed since 2023 is distributed, analysts estimate.

“This transition is chaotic and disruptive, and far from the orderly model planned in national strategies,” said Joel Nana, research director at African Tech Futures Lab. “The choice now is whether these distributed assets remain a parallel power system that compensates for grid failure or are integrated in ways that unleash a wider range of benefits.”
body.zh: 家庭和企业正在推动非洲太阳能热潮，其中屋顶阵列和其他小型系统占新太阳能装置的大部分。但分析人士表示，这种快速建设将太阳能发电量推向创纪录水平，但官方统计数据很大程度上没有考虑到这一点。 能源智库 Ember 和非洲科技期货实验室的分析师写道：“分布式太阳能在撒哈拉以南非洲的迅速普及是一个被低估的成功故事。” “然而，由于非洲国家对这一变化视而不见，他们没有在计划中反映分布式太阳能的增长。” 分析师表示，由于大多数分布式太阳能系统没有被跟踪或监管，因此大多数家庭无法将剩余电力卖回电网。最终，缺乏分布式太阳能数据可能导致各国对存储和分配太阳能所需的电池和电网基础设施投资不足，并对化石燃料投资过度。 由于缺乏官方统计数据，分析师利用海关数据来追踪从全球最大太阳能电池板制造商中国流向非洲的太阳能设备。他们发现，非洲今年将新增相当于 17 吉瓦的太阳能装机容量，足以满足非洲大陆年均增长的需求。到 2026 年，约 36 个国家的太阳能安装量将创历史新高，其中 19 个国家的太阳能安装量将是去年的两倍多。 在电网不稳定的国家，许多人依靠柴油发电机来应对经常性的停电。但分析人士表示，伊朗战争推高了柴油价格，使太阳能成为更具吸引力的替代方案。他们写道：“每三个月用柴油发电机产生与太阳能电池板相同的电力，柴油成本与太阳能电池板本身一样多。”分析师估计，自 2023 年以来，非洲几乎每个国家安装的太阳能发电量一半以上都是分布式的。 非洲科技未来实验室研究主任乔尔·纳纳表示：“这种转变是混乱和破坏性的，与国家战略中规划的有序模式相去甚远。” “现在的选择是，这些分布式资产是否仍然是一个并行电力系统，以补偿电网故障，或者以释放更广泛效益的方式进行集成。”

reflection.en: The 'underground solar boom' in Africa, where households and businesses are rapidly adopting small-scale systems, highlights a profound human capacity for discernment and innovation. As people seek practical solutions for their energy needs, they embody the wisdom of acquiring knowledge and applying it to improve daily life, even when official recognition...
reflection.zh: 非洲“地下太阳能热潮”中，家庭和企业迅速采用小型系统，这凸显了人类卓越的洞察力和创新能力。当人们寻求实用的能源解决方案时，他们体现了获取知识并将其应用于改善日常生活的智慧，即便官方认可迟迟未到。这种足智多谋的精神反映了人类深入理解和利用周围世界以造福自身的内在动力。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: A Hard-Won Rule to Cut Chemical Plant Pollution Is Being Unraveled
title.zh: 一项来之不易的削减化工厂污染的法规正在被废除

summary.en: In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.
summary.zh: 2024年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，以保护石化厂附近的社区免受有毒空气的侵害。此后，特朗普政府已向数十家污染设施授予豁免权，并正在着手修改这项期待已久的法规。

body.en:
In 2024, the Biden administration enacted wide-ranging regulations to protect communities near petrochemical plants from air toxics. The Trump administration has since granted exemptions to scores of polluting facilities and is working to rewrite the long-awaited rule.

In April 2024, Tish Taylor and her father, Robert, stood behind President Joe Biden’s Environmental Protection Agency chief, Michael Regan, as he signed a regulation designed to dramatically reduce toxic pollution from petrochemical plants like those that cluster near the Taylors’ homes along the lower Mississippi River, in Louisiana.

Taylor struggled not to cry through the signing ceremony, which followed years of demands from communities like hers — in the 85-mile corridor between New Orleans and Baton Rouge that has become known as Cancer Alley — for tighter limits on plants’ emissions. The new regulation, known as the HON rule, was “a wonderful gift to generations ahead of us,” Taylor said. “It’s hard for me to find the words to say how validated we felt.”

For decades, regulations on emissions of hazardous chemicals such as toluene, ethylene oxide, and vinyl chloride have been weaker than restrictions on more common pollutants, such as those emitted by vehicles.

The Biden administration took major steps to strengthen Clean Air Act rules on those hazardous air pollutants, and the HON rule was a centerpiece of that effort. Toughening requirements on six different pollutants at more than 200 petrochemical plants , it was one of a slate of regulations the Biden administration enacted on air toxics, each covering a specific industry, from steelmaking to tire manufacturing.

But shortly after President Donald Trump began his second term, his administration began unraveling those rules, including the one the Taylors had so recently celebrated. Last year, Trump granted two-year exemptions from the HON rule to more than 50 petrochemical facilities. This July, he issued 20 more temporary exemptions, and the EPA said it would propose a rewrite of the regulation this fall. The new version is all but certain to significantly scale back the rule’s protections.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

“Everything that the Biden administration did to help protect us was pretty much just thrown in the garbage,” Tish Taylor said in July, and replaced by “a death sentence.” St. John the Baptist Parish, where her family lives, has the country’s highest risk of cancer from air pollution — nearly 50 times the national average. A disproportionate percentage of those exposed to the highest levels of pollution in the region are Black.

A set of amendments to several existing regulations on toxic air pollutants, the HON rule — which stands for Hazardous...
body.zh: 2024 年，拜登政府颁布了广泛的法规，保护石化厂附近的社区免受空气有毒物质的影响。此后，特朗普政府已对数十家污染设施给予豁免，并正在努力重写这项期待已久的规则。 2024 年 4 月，蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲罗伯特支持乔·拜登总统的环境保护局局长迈克尔·里根签署了一项法规，旨在大幅减少石化厂（例如路易斯安那州密西西比河下游泰勒家附近聚集的石化厂）的有毒污染。 泰勒在签字仪式上努力不哭，多年来，像她这样的社区——位于新奥尔良和巴吞鲁日之间的 85 英里走廊，被称为“癌症巷”——要求更严格地限制植物排放。泰勒说，这项被称为 HON 规则的新规定是“给我们前几代人的一份美妙礼物”。 “我很难找到合适的词来表达我们的感受。” 几十年来，对甲苯、环氧乙烷和氯乙烯等危险化学品排放的法规一直弱于对车辆排放等更常见污染物的限制。 拜登政府采取了重大措施，加强《清洁空气法》对这些有害空气污染物的规定，而 HON 规定是这一努力的核心。这是拜登政府针对空气有毒物质颁布的一系列法规之一，对 200 多家石化厂的六种不同污染物提出了严格要求，每项法规都涵盖从炼钢到轮胎制造等特定行业。 但在唐纳德·特朗普总统开始第二个任期后不久，他的政府开始解开这些规则，包括泰勒家族最近庆祝的规则。去年，特朗普向 50 多家石化设施授予两年 HON 规则豁免。今年 7 月，他又发布了 20 项临时豁免，美国环保署表示将在今年秋天提议重写该法规。新版本几乎肯定会大幅缩减该规则的保护范围。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 蒂什·泰勒 (Tish Taylor) 在 7 月表示：“拜登政府为保护我们所做的一切几乎都被扔进了垃圾堆，取而代之的是“死刑”。她家人居住的施洗者圣约翰教区因空气污染而患癌症的风险是全国最高的——几乎是全国平均水平的 50 倍。在该地区暴露于最高污染水平的人群中，黑人所占比例过高。 HON 规则是对多项有关有毒空气污染物的现行法规的一系列修正案，它代表危险……

reflection.en: The story of Tish Taylor and her father, who stood by as a vital regulation was signed to protect communities from toxic air, highlights the constant need for leaders to uphold justice. Yahweh's word in Jeremiah 22:3 calls those in authority to "do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed." When hard-won...
reflection.zh: 蒂什·泰勒和她的父亲见证了一项旨在保护社区免受有毒空气侵害的重要法规的签署，这个故事凸显了领导者维护正义的持续必要性。雅伟在耶利米书22:3中的话语呼吁掌权者“施行公平和公义，从欺压者手中拯救被抢夺的”。当像密西西比河下游沿岸社区这样脆弱的群体，他们来之不易的保护措施受到威胁时，这提醒我们，在灵性和人性上，都需要有公义的治理来保障所有人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 电影制作人 Douglas Keeve 于 1995 年拍摄的纪录片《Unzipped》讲述了时装设计师、后来的大亨 Isaac Mizrahi（当时是导演的男友）走进他 1994 年秋季系列的故事。这部以 90 年代为中心的电影仍然是当时纽约高级时尚界的终极写照，客串包括辛迪·克劳馥、娜奥米·坎贝尔、琳达·伊万格丽斯塔和凯特·莫斯。此外，该片还获得了1995年圣丹斯电影节观众奖。现在，杰纳斯电影公司正在通过新的修复将这部电影带回影院。观看下面的预告片。 Janus Films 提供的概要如下：“设计师 Isaac Mizrahi 在 1994 年秋季系列的传奇之路上证明了自然的力量，这是一场定义职业生涯的胜利，Mizrahi 当时的合作伙伴 Douglas Keeve 热情洋溢地亲密记录了这一胜利。这既是一个充满活力、喧闹的 1990 年代的时间胶囊，当时流行文化和高雅艺术可以互换，也是一个这幅开创性的艺术肖像画由艾伦·库拉斯 (Ellen Kuras) 和罗伯特·利科克 (Robert Leacock) 精心拍摄，以真实风格、现场报道的方式记录了创作过程中日常的痛苦和狂喜，超越了浮华和魅力，以非凡的视角展示了天才固有的魅力和意志力，以及其个人成本。”相关故事雷德利·斯科特讲述从《塞尔玛与路易丝》到《狗明星》的爱情故事，用 11 个摄像机拍摄，以及为什么沉默是最好的音效《起义》认为需要罗宾汉，但农民的起义已经足够令人兴奋 Charli XCX 最近告诉《Vogue》：“这部由 Douglas Keeve 执导的影片讲述了 Isaac Mizrahi 为纽约时装周系列做准备的故事。如果你热爱时尚，你一定要看看这部纪录片。所有的传奇人物都在其中——Kate、Naomi、Christy——甚至 Galliano 和 Polly Mellen。但最重要的是，这部电影完美地捕捉了艺术家的创作过程：灵感的爆发、自我怀疑、脆弱，以及最后的胜利。” Janus Films 将于 9 月 25 日星期五在纽约电影论坛上放映《Unzipped》。然后，影片将于 10 月 9 日星期五在洛杉矶的莱姆勒皇家和格伦代尔上映。随后将在全国上映。圣丹斯学院和加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆对这部电影进行了数字修复。 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Unzipped' offers a glimpse into the intense dedication and creative labor behind Isaac Mizrahi's 1994 fall fashion collection. It showcases the passion and effort poured into bringing a vision to life, reminding us that all work, whether in design or any other field, can be offered as a service to God.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》让我们得以一窥艾萨克·米兹拉希1994年秋季时装系列背后倾注的专注和创造性劳动。它展示了将一个愿景变为现实所付出的热情和努力，提醒我们，所有工作，无论是在设计领域还是其他任何领域，都可以作为对雅伟的服事。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Guardian-produced Gaza documentary from Oscar-winning Israeli directors of No Other Land to screen at Venice film festival
title.zh: Guardian制作的加沙纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演执导，将在威尼斯电影节上映

summary.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham...
summary.zh: 由奥斯卡获奖以色列导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕和雷切尔·索尔（与巴塞尔·阿德拉和哈姆丹·巴拉尔共同执导《无他之地》）执导的《卫报》制作的加沙纪录片，将调查战争期间“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”，并将在威尼斯电影节首映。这部名为《NAZA》的电影由吉姆·威尔逊制作，乔纳森·格雷泽（《利益区域》团队）担任执行制片人，是今...

body.en: Film directed by Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, co-directors of No Other Land along with Basel Adra and Hamdan Ballal , investigates ‘Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians’ during the war A new documentary about Israel’s bombing campaign in Gaza, directed by Oscar-winning directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor and produced by the Guardian, is to receive its world premiere at the Venice film festival. The film, called NAZA, has been produced with Jim Wilson and executive produced by Jonathan Glazer, the team behind The Zone of Interest, and is the only documentary that will compete this year for Venice’s prestigious Golden Lion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary, "NAZA," premiering at the Venice Film Festival, seeks to bring to light the alleged "calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians" in Gaza. In a world where many suffer in silence, such efforts to investigate and expose injustice embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. Yahweh's word reminds us of the...
reflection.zh: 这部名为《NAZA》的纪录片将在威尼斯电影节首映，旨在揭露加沙地带“以色列对巴勒斯坦平民的蓄意大规模杀戮”。在一个许多人默默承受苦难的世界里，这种调查和揭露不公的努力，体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召。雅伟的话语提醒我们，为贫困者的权利发声并确保他们的故事被听见，是一项道德责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘We’re barely above porn’: why would a film-maker choose to make a deliberately bad ‘mockbuster’?
title.zh: “我们几乎比色情片好不了多少”：为什么电影制作人会选择制作一部故意拍得很烂的“恶搞电影”？

summary.en: Filmmaker Anthony Frith directed a low-budget "mockbuster" in six days for the studio behind Sharknado, then created a documentary about the experience. The article discusses the critical reception of his intentionally "bad" film.
summary.zh: 电影制作人安东尼·弗里斯为《鲨卷风》背后的工作室，仅用六天时间执导了一部低成本的“恶搞电影”，随后又制作了一部关于这次经历的纪录片。文章探讨了评论界对这部他有意为之的“烂片”的评价。

body.en: With a tiny budget and six days, Anthony Frith directed a film for the studio behind Sharknado – and then made Mockbuster, a documentary about the experience Directors don’t tend to appreciate having their films eviscerated by critics. And us critics, well practised in lobbing proverbial grenades from the safety of our pretentiously book-lined, Cahiers du Cinéma-strewn offices, don’t tend to look an artist in the eyes and tell them that their work sucks. This is, however, exactly what I do to the Australian film-maker Anthony Frith. I’ve even prepared a zinger for the occasion. “Your film is a lemon that’s been eaten by a turkey then dumped into a vat of curdled mayonnaise,” I say. Continue reading...
body.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯 (Anthony Frith) 用有限的预算和六天的时间为《Sharknado》背后的工作室执导了一部电影，然后制作了《Mockbuster》，这是一部讲述导演们不喜欢自己的电影被评论家挖空的经历的纪录片。而我们的影评人，在我们自命不凡的书籍林立、电影手册散布的办公室里，熟练地投掷众所周知的手榴弹，不会倾向于直视艺术家的眼睛，告诉他们他们的作品很糟糕。然而，这正是我对澳大利亚电影制片人安东尼·弗里斯所做的。我什至还为这个场合准备了一杯辛格酒。 “你的电影是一个被火鸡吃掉的柠檬，然后倒入一桶凝结的蛋黄酱中，”我说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Anthony Frith's commitment to directing a film in just six days, even a "mockbuster" that he knew would face harsh criticism, highlights the intrinsic value of effort. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to work heartily, as for Yahweh and not for men, suggesting that the dignity of our labor comes from our intention and dedication, not solely from the outcome or...
reflection.zh: 安东尼·弗里斯仅用六天时间执导一部电影，即便他知道这部“恶搞电影”会面临严厉批评，他的这种投入精神突显了努力的内在价值。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的。这表明我们劳动的尊严源于我们的意图和奉献，而不仅仅是结果或评论界的赞誉。这种视角能将最非传统或看似“糟糕”的项目，转化为有意义的努力。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries …
title.zh: 穆里尼奥影评——如果他不想敞开心扉，也许他就不该出演纪录片……

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,
summary.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥主演了一部三集纪录片，由《兄弟：尖叫停止后》的创作者制作。别指望它会那么有趣……这部迷你剧的导演乔·珀尔曼之前的作品包括2018年那部揭露性十足又滑稽的电影，

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: ‘Possible Love’ Trailer: ‘Burning’ Director Lee Chang-dong Returns with a Story of Documentary Filmmaking Gone Awry
title.zh: 《可能的爱》预告片：《燃烧》导演李沧东携纪录片失控故事回归

summary.en: Netflix is set to release "Possible Love," a new film from acclaimed director Lee Chang-dong, in theaters on Friday, October 23, following its Venice premiere. The film is described as a story of documentary filmmaking gone awry, continuing the director's tradition of capturing human despair.
summary.zh: 备受赞誉的导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》将于10月23日星期五在威尼斯首映后在影院上映。这部电影被描述为一个纪录片制作失控的故事，延续了导演捕捉人类绝望的传统。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

A new film from Lee Chang-dong is always a major event on the cinema calendar . The South Korean auteur has directed six movies since 1997, each one demonstrating his literary sensibilities and keen eye for capturing human despair. And ever since his seventh film, the upcoming “ Possible Love ,” was announced, cinephiles have been preparing to have their hearts broken.

“Possible Love” is loosely based on a segment of Krzysztof Kieślowski’s “Dekalog,” making it the second film of 2026 to take inspiration from the ten-part film that explored modern interpretations of the Ten Commandments. (The first was Asghar Farhadi’s “Parallel Lives,” which premiered to Cannes to mixed reviews.) The film explores the secrets hidden beneath marriages, following two married couples whose lives intersect while filming a documentary together. Related Stories Indie Films Should Tour Like a Band ‘Idiots’ Review: Macon Blair Merges ‘The Last Detail’ with ‘Road Trip’ in a Wildly Uneven Comedy That Fails to Find Its Own Lane

“Possible Love” stars Jeon Do-yeon, Sul Kyung-gu, Zo In-sung, and Cho Yeo-jeong. Lee co-wrote the film with Oh Jung-mi.

An official synopsis for the film reads: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

“Possible Love” will have its world premiere at the 2026 Venice International Film Festival , where it will compete for the Golden Lion. It will go on to screen at the Toronto International Film Festival before Netflix releases it domestically in October. The film has been selected as South Korea’s official submission to the Best International Feature category at the 99th Academy Awards.

While Lee has not released a film in eight years, he has remained active in the world of literature and continued to promote repertory screenings of his work. In a 2024 interview with IndieWire , he reflected on the thematic threads connecting his entire filmography.

“Everyone unexpectedly faces pain and suffers from hopelessness and failure,” Lee said. “That is life. The world unjustly suppresses and gives pain to an individual. The problem is how you cope with the pain. Thus, the struggle is more important than the pain itself. Through the struggle, humans find the purpose of life and find salvation. Protagonists in tragedies are those types of people. I tried to...
body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 李沧东的新片永远是电影日历上的一件大事。这位韩国导演自 1997 年以来执导了六部电影，每一部电影都展示了他的文学敏感性和捕捉人类绝望的敏锐眼光。自从他的第七部电影即将上映的《可能的爱》宣布以来，影迷们就已经做好了心碎的准备。 《可能的爱》大致改编自克日什托夫·基斯洛夫斯基的《十诫》中的一个片段，这使其成为 2026 年第二部从这部探讨十诫现代诠释的十集电影中汲取灵感的电影。 （第一部是阿斯加尔·法哈迪的《平行生活》，该片在戛纳首映，评价褒贬不一。）这部电影探讨了隐藏在婚姻之下的秘密，讲述了两对已婚夫妇在一起拍摄纪录片时生活交叉的故事。相关故事独立电影应该像乐队一样巡回演出《白痴》评论：梅肯·布莱尔将《最后的细节》与《公路旅行》融合在一部极其不平衡的喜剧中，但未能找到自己的道路 《可能的爱情》由全度妍、薛景求、赵寅成、曹汝贞主演。李与吴正美共同编剧了这部电影。 影片的官方剧情简介如下：一名下岗工人和他的妻子与一名纪录片制片人和她的配偶相遇，并面对他们隐藏的欲望。 《可能的爱情》将在2026年威尼斯国际电影节全球首映，角逐金狮奖。该片将在多伦多国际电影节上放映，然后 Netflix 将于 10 月份在国内上映。该片已被选为韩国正式提交的第 99 届奥斯卡金像奖最佳国际影片奖。 尽管李已经八年没有发行电影了，但他仍然活跃在文学界，并继续推动其作品的剧目放映。在 2024 年接受 IndieWire 采访时，他反思了连接他整个电影作品的主题线索。 “每个人都会意外地面临痛苦、绝望和失败，”李说。 “这就是生活。这个世界不公正地压制和给予一个人痛苦。问题是你如何应对痛苦。因此，斗争比痛苦本身更重要。通过斗争，人类找到了生活的目的，找到了救赎。悲剧的主角就是这样的人。我试图……

reflection.en: Director Lee Chang-dong's new film, "Possible Love," promises to delve into "human despair" and leave audiences "brokenhearted" as it explores documentary filmmaking gone awry. In a world where stories often highlight profound suffering, Psalm 34:18 reminds us that Yahweh is near to those who are brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit. This offers a...
reflection.zh: 导演李沧东的新片《可能的爱》承诺将深入探讨“人类的绝望”，并随着纪录片制作的失控而让观众“心碎”。在一个故事常常凸显深重苦难的世界里，诗篇34:18提醒我们，雅伟亲近伤心的人，拯救灵里破碎的人。这提供了一种安静的盼望，即使面对生命中最艰难的现实，神圣的同在也与那些受苦的人同在。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: How the mob took Hollywood: the story of organized crime and the movies
title.zh: 黑帮如何掌控好莱坞：有组织犯罪与电影的故事

summary.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series,...
summary.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮掌控电影业》回顾了犯罪分子如何渗透电影业。该三部曲纪录片的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森称：“从好莱坞创立之初，有组织犯罪就已存在。”

body.en: Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies looks back at how criminals insinuated themselves in the film business “From the foundation of Hollywood, organized crime is there.” So claims Tom Patterson, producer and director of new three-part documentary series, Hollywood Crime Story: The Mob Takes Over the Movies. Organized crime’s connection to the film industry actually predates Tinseltown, being present for the foundation of the medium itself, when inventor Thomas Edison sicced his hired goons on competitors in an attempt to maintain total control over early motion picture technology. As covered in Hollywood Crime Story, this resulted in said competitors – mostly Jewish businessmen from the east coast – fleeing westward and establishing the town and studio system that would become synonymous with movies as we know them. Continue reading...
body.zh: 《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》回顾了犯罪分子如何潜入电影行业“从好莱坞的根基开始，有组织的犯罪就在那里。”新的三集纪录片系列《好莱坞犯罪故事：黑帮接管电影》的制片人兼导演汤姆·帕特森如是说。有组织犯罪与电影业的联系实际上早于好莱坞，当时发明家托马斯·爱迪生（Thomas Edison）为了保持对早期电影技术的完全控制，而雇佣了暴徒来对付竞争对手，这一点就为电影本身奠定了基础。正如《好莱坞犯罪故事》中所报道的那样，这导致上述竞争对手（主要是来自东海岸的犹太商人）向西逃亡，并建立了城镇和制片厂系统，该系统将成为我们所知的电影的代名词。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "Hollywood Crime Story" reveals how organized crime, driven by the pursuit of wealth and power, embedded itself in the film industry from its very beginning, even with figures like Thomas Edison using "hired goons." This historical account reminds us that the love of money can indeed be a root of all kinds of evil, corrupting even creative...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《好莱坞犯罪故事》揭示了有组织犯罪如何从电影业的早期，甚至从托马斯·爱迪生使用“雇佣打手”开始，就因对财富和权力的追求而渗透其中。这个历史记载提醒我们，贪爱钱财确实是万恶之根，它能腐蚀社会中富有创造力和影响力的领域。这凸显了在面对非法利益的诱惑时，保持正直所需的持续警惕。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Hanging By a Wire review – cable car rescue documentary dangles viewers on the edge of disaster
title.zh: 《悬挂在钢丝上》影评——缆车救援纪录片让观众悬在灾难边缘

summary.en: The documentary "Hanging By a Wire" recounts the tense survival story of eight people trapped in a cable car above a chasm in Pakistan, featuring their extraordinary fate and daring rescue.
summary.zh: 纪录片《悬挂在钢丝上》讲述了八名被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方缆车中的人们惊心动魄的生存故事，展现了他们非凡的命运和大胆的救援行动。

body.en: The extraordinary fate of eight people trapped above a chasm in Pakistan makes for a tense, skilfully assembled survival story with unexpected flashes of comedy Survival documentaries are a weird little genre of nonfiction film-making that recount the stories of accidents and natural catastrophes – and more often than not, the daring rescues of people caught up in them. Eyewitnesses and the loved ones of those endangered are top of the interview list, to keep the sense of danger and emotional stakes at the top of everyone’s mind. Survivors can also have their say, and more adventurous film-makers might care to recreate the action with actors or the actual survivors themselves. This account of how eight people – six teenage boys and two adult men – were left suspended over a chasm in northern Pakistan in 2023, when a wire on the cable car they were travelling on broke, is a pretty conventional example of the form. For obvious reasons, no one tries to recreate the situation, but since it was quite recent there is no shortage of news footage and amateur clips to fill out the particulars. The downside of doing a story that’s so recent is that some of the audience may remember what happened anyway, but still there’s plenty of nail-nibbling suspense here, and sequences that will give anyone with acrophobia the heebie jeebies – especially the drone shots that zoom close on the terrified faces of those trapped inside the dangling car. Continue reading...
body.zh: 八个人被困在巴基斯坦的深渊上，他们的非凡命运造就了一个紧张而巧妙的生存故事，其中有意想不到的喜剧闪现。生存纪录片是一种奇怪的非虚构电影制作类型，讲述了事故和自然灾害的故事，而且往往讲述了被困人员的勇敢营救。目击者和那些濒临灭绝的人的亲人是采访的首要对象，以便让每个人都牢记危险感和情感风险。幸存者也可以发表意见，更具冒险精神的电影制作人可能会愿意与演员或真正的幸存者本人一起重现动作。这个故事描述了 2023 年，八个人（六名十几岁的男孩和两名成年男子）在巴基斯坦北部的一个峡谷上悬吊着，当时他们乘坐的缆车上的电线断裂了，这是这种形式的一个非常传统的例子。出于显而易见的原因，没有人试图重现这种情况，但由于这是最近发生的事情，因此不乏新闻片段和业余剪辑来填充细节。制作一个最近发生的故事的缺点是，一些观众可能会记得发生了什么，但这里仍然有很多令人紧张的悬念，以及会让任何有恐高症的人感到惊慌的序列——尤其是无人机拍摄的镜头，近距离拍摄那些被困在悬空的汽车里的人惊恐的面孔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The harrowing ordeal of eight individuals suspended above a chasm in a Pakistani cable car reminds us of how vulnerable life can be when disaster strikes. In such moments of extreme peril, the human spirit yearns for a refuge and strength beyond its own, a help that is truly ever-present. Yahweh is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble,...
reflection.zh: 八名乘客被困在巴基斯坦峡谷上方的缆车中，这惊心动魄的经历提醒我们，当灾难降临时，生命是多么脆弱。在如此极度的危险时刻，人的心灵渴望超越自身的力量，寻求一个真正无处不在的避难所和力量。雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助，当面对压倒性的挑战时，祂赐予我们安慰和支持。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Martin Short Explains Why He’s Never Seen a Shrink: ‘It’s OK to Be Sad’
title.zh: 马丁·肖特解释为何从未看过心理医生：‘悲伤是可以的’

reflection.en: Martin Short's reflection on enduring "Job-like" personal tragedies, stating "It's OK to Be Sad," resonates deeply with the biblical truth that grief is a natural human response to loss. Even Yahweh, in human form, wept at the death of a friend, showing that sorrow is not a weakness but a profound expression of love and humanity. His ability to acknowledge...
reflection.zh: 马丁·肖特在经历“约伯式”个人悲剧后，表示“悲伤是可以的”，这与圣经中悲伤是人类对失落的自然反应这一真理深深契合。即使是道成肉身的雅伟，也曾为朋友的离世而哭泣，这表明悲伤并非软弱，而是爱与人性的深刻表达。他能够承认并承受自己的悲伤，而非压抑它，这体现了一种在拥抱人类情感全貌中找到的平静力量。

title.en: ‘Boorman and the Devil’ Review: This Deep Dive Into How ‘Exorcist II: The Heretic’ Spiraled Out of Control Deserves a Wide Release
title.zh: 《布尔曼与魔鬼》评论：深入探讨《驱魔人 II：异端》如何失控，值得广泛发布

summary.en: David Kittredge conjures a true film lover's retrospective in this magical John Boorman documentary.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自纪录片栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Editor’s note: This review was originally published on October 24, 2025 out of the 2025 Brooklyn Horror Film Festival. Yellow Veil Pictures will release the film at NYC’s Quad Cinema on Friday, August 28, with expansion to follow.

David Kittredge delivers a dazzling reflection on the career of John Boorman in the documentary “ Boorman and the Devil ,” a robust reframing of the legendary director’s “ Exorcist II: The Heretic ,” as strange and poetic as the disastrous 1977 production itself.

These days, Boorman’s much-maligned sequel to William Friedkin’s supernatural masterpiece is best known as a string of memes. You’ve got James Earl Jones dressed as a giant locust . Linda Blair tap-dancing her demons away . Even the film’s core concept of The Synchronizer, a baffling psychic invention from the script that not only vexed audiences but forced unionized crew members to debate whether the thing was a light or a prop. Related Stories ‘The Dog Stars’ Review: Jacob Elordi and Josh Brolin Can’t Save Ridley Scott’s Bizarrely Inert Post-Apocalypse Movie from Near-Disaster Dolly Parton, Iconic Singer/Songwriter and ‘9 to 5’ Star, Dies at 80

An embarrassment of riches for behind-the-scenes factoids, “Exorcist II: The Heretic” is a lot more than a punchline and as memorable as any real train wreck. If you already like the 1977 movie (and I’ll tell you right now, you should !), then “Boorman and the Devil” might not make the argument that it’s objectively good as fiercely as you’d like . But for those who hate “Exorcist II” or just haven’t seen it, Kittredge provides a sparkling on-ramp to New Hollywood history and Boorman’s astonishing career. (Note: The film also features IndieWire’s Jim Hemphill as a talking head.)

92 years old now, Boorman debuted in black-and-white with “Catch Us If You Can” (1965), before canoeing to the Oscars with Jon Voight in “Deliverance” (1972) and blasting off into batshit space with Sean Connery and a fur bikini for “Zardoz” (1974) . At the top of his game when he was offered the chance to direct the original “Exorcist” over Friedkin, the British cinephile declined, and embraced his own original and audacious visions instead. body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 编者注：这篇评论最初于 2025 年 10 月 24 日在 2025 年布鲁克林恐怖电影节上发表。 Yellow Veil Pictures 将于 8 月 28 日星期五在纽约市的 Quad Cinema 上映这部电影，随后将进行扩展。 大卫·基特里奇在纪录片《布尔曼与魔鬼》中对约翰·布尔曼的职业生涯进行了令人眼花缭乱的反思，这部纪录片对这位传奇导演的《驱魔人 II：异端》进行了强有力的重构，就像 1977 年灾难性的作品本身一样奇怪而富有诗意。 如今，布尔曼饱受诟病的威廉·弗里德金超自然杰作的续集最为人所知的是一系列模因。詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯打扮成一只巨大的蝗虫。琳达·布莱尔 (Linda Blair) 跳着踢踏舞赶走内心的恶魔。甚至电影的核心概念“同步器”，剧本中令人费解的灵异发明，不仅让观众烦恼，还迫使工会成员争论这个东西是灯光还是道具。相关故事《狗明星》评论：雅各布·埃洛迪和乔什·布洛林无法拯救雷德利·斯科特执导的这部近乎灾难的奇异惰性后启示录电影 标志性歌手/词曲作家、《朝九晚五》明星多莉·帕顿去世，享年 80 岁 对于幕后花絮来说，《驱魔人 II：异端》是一个令人尴尬的财富，它不仅仅是一个笑点，而且像任何真正的火车失事一样令人难忘。如果你已经喜欢这部 1977 年的电影（我现在就告诉你，你应该喜欢！），那么《布尔曼与魔鬼》可能不会像你想象的那样客观地表现出它的精彩。但对于那些讨厌《驱魔人 II》或还没看过它的人来说，基特里奇为了解新好莱坞历史和布尔曼惊人的职业生涯提供了一个闪亮的入口。 （注：这部电影还邀请了 IndieWire 的吉姆·亨普希尔（Jim Hemphill）担任演讲嘉宾。） 现年 92 岁的布尔曼以黑白片《抓住我们》（1965 年）首次亮相，随后在《拯救》（1972 年）中与乔恩·沃特一起划独木舟前往奥斯卡颁奖典礼，并在《扎尔多兹》（1974 年）中与肖恩·康纳利一起穿着毛皮比基尼进入了疯狂的空间。在他事业的巅峰时期，当他有机会执导原版《驱魔人》而不是弗里德金时，这位英国影迷拒绝了，转而拥抱自己原创而大胆的愿景。当制片厂系统回到布尔曼的《驱魔人 II》时，好莱坞正处于……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。
